cases.name: three-queued-then-one-ready
cases.detail: ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-alpha ATM_TEAM=fx-at10 atm task assign fx-at10-beta ... --task-id at10-case1{a,b,c}-1789411530 --json -> {"task_id":"at10-case1a-1789411530"}, {"task_id":"at10-case1b-1789411530"}, {"task_id":"at10-case1c-1789411530"}. After each assignment, atm list --pending-ack --json --as fx-at10-beta --team fx-at10 -> {"selection_mode":"pending_ack","count":0,"rows":[],"bucket_counts":{"pending_ack":0,...}} all three times (unread climbed 1,2,3 while pending_ack stayed 0). atm task list --json (as fx-at10-beta) -> positions 1,2,3 for case1a/b/c respectively, all state "assigned". atm task events at10-case1a...--json handoffs contain {"kind":"task_queued"} then {"kind":"task_ready","trigger":"task_pass"}; atm task events at10-case1b...--json and at10-case1c...--json handoffs contain only {"kind":"task_queued"} (no task_ready) -- exactly one ready task.

cases.name: close-releases-next
cases.detail: ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-beta ATM_TEAM=fx-at10 atm task start at10-case1a-1789411530 --json then atm task close at10-case1a-1789411530 completed --json both -> {"action":"send","outcome":"sent",...}. Polled atm task events at10-case1b-1789411530 --json at 1s intervals; ready at poll 2 (2s): handoffs contains {"agent":"fx-at10-beta","kind":"task_ready","trigger":"task_pass","task_id":"at10-case1b-1789411530"}. atm task list --json (as fx-at10-beta) confirmed case1b now {"position":1,"state":"assigned","last_reminded_at":"2026-09-14T18:45:40.807094365Z"}.

cases.name: reassign-notifies-both
cases.detail: ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-alpha ATM_TEAM=fx-at10 atm task assign fx-at10-beta 'case3 task' --task-id at10-case3-1789411552 --json then, while still queued for beta, atm task assign fx-at10-gamma 'case3 task reassigned' --task-id at10-case3-1789411552 --json (same task-id) -> {"task_id":"at10-case3-1789411552"}. atm task events at10-case3-1789411552 --json shows seq3 {"event":"reassigned","assignee":"fx-at10-gamma","from_state":"assigned","to_state":"assigned"} and handoffs {"agent":"fx-at10-beta","kind":"task_closed"} then {"agent":"fx-at10-gamma","kind":"task_queued"} then {"agent":"fx-at10-gamma","kind":"task_ready"}. atm read --message-id 01M2GKTZKMPNNNT7SEGDATXAA2 --json (as fx-at10-beta) -> message.text="task at10-case3-1789411552 was reassigned to fx-at10-gamma", summary="task_closed:at10-case3-1789411552". atm task list --json (as fx-at10-gamma) -> [{"task_id":"at10-case3-1789411552","state":"assigned","position":1}]; atm task list --json (as fx-at10-beta) -> [].

cases.name: move-head-readies-once
cases.detail: Assigned at10-case4a-1789411577 then at10-case4b-1789411577 to idle beta (alpha). Polled atm task events at10-case4a...--json; ready at poll 4 (handoffs has exactly one {"kind":"task_ready"} for case4a). ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-beta atm task move at10-case4b-1789411577 --head --json -> {"from":2,"to":1}. After 3s, atm task events at10-case4b...--json handoffs shows exactly one {"kind":"task_ready","task_id":"at10-case4b-1789411577"} (events also show a "moved" entry "detail":"2\u21921"). Re-checked atm task events at10-case4a...--json: handoffs still contains exactly one {"kind":"task_ready"} entry (same single occurrence as before the move) -- no duplicate on either task. atm task list --json confirmed case4b now position 1, case4a position 2.

cases.name: cancel-notifies-assignee
cases.detail: ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-alpha ATM_TEAM=fx-at10 atm task assign fx-at10-beta 'case5 task' --task-id at10-case5-1789411601 --json then immediately atm task close at10-case5-1789411601 cancelled 'case5 cancelled before start' --json (still queued, never started) -> {"outcome":"sent",...}. atm task events at10-case5-1789411601 --json (as fx-at10-beta) seq2 -> {"event":"cancelled","close_outcome":"cancelled","from_state":"assigned","to_state":"complete","detail":"case5 cancelled before start"}, handoffs [...,{"agent":"fx-at10-beta","kind":"task_closed"}]. atm list --all --task at10-case5-1789411601 --json (as fx-at10-beta) rows[0]={"message_id":"01M2GKWAPBSEEB0HDJT8G0S3Y0","summary":"case5 cancelled before start","from":"fx-at10-alpha","task_id":"at10-case5-1789411601"} -- cancelled terminal outcome delivered to beta.

cases.name: busy-assigner-sees-terminal-lines
cases.detail: ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-gamma atm task assign fx-at10-alpha 'keep alpha busy' --task-id at10-case6-busy-1789411614 --json, then ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-alpha atm task start at10-case6-busy-1789411614 --json. atm task list --json (as fx-at10-alpha) BEFORE beta's work -> [{"task_id":"at10-case6-busy-1789411614","state":"active","assignee":"fx-at10-alpha","assigner":"fx-at10-gamma","position":1}]. Then ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-alpha atm task assign fx-at10-beta 'case6 work for beta' --task-id at10-case6-work-1789411614 --json; ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-beta atm task start ...--json; ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at10-beta atm task close ... completed --json. atm task events at10-case6-work-1789411614 --json (as fx-at10-alpha) events[] in order: seq1 assigned, seq2 {"event":"started","from_state":"assigned","to_state":"active","at":"...18:46:58.998301437Z"}, seq3 {"event":"completed","close_outcome":"completed","from_state":"active","to_state":"complete","at":"...18:46:59.005026051Z"}; handoffs[] show {"agent":"fx-at10-alpha","kind":"task_started"} then {"agent":"fx-at10-alpha","kind":"task_complete"} -- started before completed, both present in alpha's history while alpha's own task was still active.

cases.name: cleanup
cases.detail: Closed every task created: at10-case1a/b/c-1789411530 (completed x3), at10-case3-1789411552 (completed, on gamma after reassign), at10-case4a/b-1789411577 (completed x2), at10-case5-1789411601 (already terminal via cancel), at10-case6-busy-1789411614 (completed) and at10-case6-work-1789411614 (completed via beta). Final: atm task list --json -> [] for fx-at10-alpha, fx-at10-beta, and fx-at10-gamma.
